en-US.longDescription: Windows Repair is a tool designed to help fix a vast majority of known Windows problems, including; registry errors, file permissions, issues with Internet Explorer, Windows Updates, Windows Firewall, and more. Malware and poorly installed programs can modify your default settings resulting in your machine working poorly. With Tweaking.com Windows Repair, you can restore Windows original settings fixing many of these problems outright.
